newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine amends APP Global Finance FRN pay date.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine amends APP Global Finance FRN pay date.

text.p: Peregrine Fixed Income said on Friday it has amended the pay date on the following issue to April 17 from April 18, 1997.
All other terms are unchanged.
The issue was priced this morning at par to float at 425 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate, Peregrine said.
Peregrine also said the issue size has been raised to US$500 million from US$400 million at launch, Peregrine said.
The issue was launched in mid-March. Syndication will close next Monday.
